648:     // ───────────── navigation ─────────────
649:     pub fn navigate(&mut self, r: Route) {
650:         if self.hist.get(self.hist_i) == Some(&r) && !self.entries.is_empty() {
651:             return;
652:         }
653:         self.hist.truncate(self.hist_i + 1);
654:         self.hist.push(r.clone());
655:         self.hist_i = self.hist.len() - 1;
656:         self.go(r);
657:     }
658:     fn go(&mut self, r: Route) {
659:         self.route = r.clone();
660:         // Smart contextual sorting: Downloads is almost always "what did I just get?",
661:         // so newest-first wins there unless the user turned smart sort off.
662:         if self.st().smart_sort {
663:             if let Route::Loc(l) = &r {
664:                 let base = l.name().to_ascii_lowercase();
665:                 if base == "downloads" || base == "download" {
666:                     self.set(|s| {
667:                         s.sort = SortKey::Modified;
668:                         s.ascending = false;
669:                     });
670:                 }
671:             }
672:         }
673:         self.sel.clear();
674:         self.select_mode = false;
675:         self.anchor = None;
676:         self.focus = None;
677:         self.rename = None;
678:         self.clear_search();
679:         self.scroll_to = Some(0);
680:         self.load();
681:     }
682:     pub fn can_back(&self) -> bool {
683:         self.hist_i > 0
684:     }
685:     pub fn can_fwd(&self) -> bool {
686:         self.hist_i + 1 < self.hist.len()
687:     }
688:     pub fn load(&mut self) {
689:         self.loading = true;
690:         self.error = None;
691:         match self.route.clone() {
692:             Route::Loc(l) => {
693:                 self.listing_req = self.be.list(&l);
694:                 self.be.watch(&l);
695:             }
696:             Route::Recents => {
697:                 // Tombstones: drop recents whose files no longer exist so
698:                 // Recents never accumulates ghosts of deleted files.
699:                 let mut lib = self.be.library.write().unwrap();
700:                 let pruned = lib.prune_missing_recents(|l| self.be.stat(l).is_ok());
701:                 drop(lib);
702:                 if pruned > 0 {
703:                     self.toast(format!("Cleaned {} missing item{} from Recents", pruned, if pruned == 1 { "" } else { "s" }), true);
704:                 }
705:                 let recents = self.lib(|l| l.recents.clone());
706:                 let items: Vec<Entry> = recents.iter().filter_map(|r| self.be.stat(&r.loc).ok()).collect();
707:                 self.set_entries(items);
708:             }
709:             Route::Tag(id) => {
710:                 let locs = self.lib(|l| l.tagged(&id));
711:                 let items: Vec<Entry> = locs.iter().filter_map(|l| self.be.stat(l).ok()).collect();
712:                 self.set_entries(items);
713:             }
714:             Route::Trash => {
715:                 // Trash list is drawn from smart_core::trash entries, not VFS items.
716:                 self.entries.clear();
717:                 self.items.clear();
718:                 self.loading = false;
719:                 self.error = None;
720:             }
721:             Route::Storage => {
722:                 let root = self.be.home();
723:                 if self.scan_root.as_ref() != Some(&root) {
724:                     self.scan = Some(smart_core::scan::Scan::new(self.be.registry.clone(), &root));
725:                     self.scan_root = Some(root);
726:                 }
727:                 self.entries.clear();
728:                 self.items.clear();
729:                 self.loading = false;
730:                 self.error = None;
731:             }
732:         }
733:     }
734:     pub fn title(&self) -> String {
735:         match &self.route {
736:             Route::Recents => "Recents".into(),
737:             Route::Trash => "Trash".into(),
738:             Route::Storage => "Storage".into(),
739:             Route::Tag(id) => self.lib(|l| l.tags.iter().find(|t| &t.id == id).map(|t| t.name.clone())).unwrap_or_else(|| id.clone()),
740:             Route::Loc(l) => self.loc_title(l),
741:         }
742:     }
743:     pub fn loc_title(&self, l: &Location) -> String {
744:         if let Some(p) = self.places.iter().find(|p| &p.loc == l) {
745:             return p.title.clone();
746:         }
747:         if l.is_root() {
748:             if let Some(d) = self.devices.iter().find(|d| d.loc.as_ref() == Some(l)) {
749:                 return d.name.clone();
750:             }
751:             return if l.fs == "file" { "Computer".into() } else { l.fs.clone() };
752:         }
753:         l.name()
754:     }
755:     pub fn crumbs(&self) -> Vec<(String, Route)> {
756:         match &self.route {
757:             Route::Recents => vec![("Smart".into(), Route::Loc(self.be.home())), ("Recents".into(), Route::Recents)],
758:             Route::Trash => vec![("Smart".into(), Route::Loc(self.be.home())), ("Trash".into(), Route::Trash)],
759:             Route::Storage => vec![("Smart".into(), Route::Loc(self.be.home())), ("Storage".into(), Route::Storage)],
760:             Route::Tag(_) => vec![("Tags".into(), Route::Recents), (self.title(), self.route.clone())],
761:             Route::Loc(l) => {
762:                 let home = self.be.home();
763:                 let mut v: Vec<(String, Route)> = vec![];
764:                 if l.starts_with(&home) {
765:                     v.push(("Smart".into(), Route::Loc(home.clone())));
766:                     for a in l.ancestors().iter().filter(|a| a.starts_with(&home) && **a != home) {
767:                         v.push((a.name(), Route::Loc(a.clone())));
768:                     }
769:                     if *l == home {
770:                         v.push(("Home".into(), Route::Loc(home)));
771:                     }
772:                 } else {
773:                     for a in l.ancestors() {
774:                         v.push((self.loc_title(&a), Route::Loc(a)));
775:                     }
776:                 }
777:                 v
778:             }
779:         }
780:     }

782:     // ───────────── listing / view ─────────────
783:     pub fn set_entries(&mut self, e: Vec<Entry>) {
784:         self.entries = e;
785:         self.loading = false;
786:         self.rebuild_view();
787:         let want: Vec<Location> = std::mem::take(&mut self.select_after_list);
788:         if !want.is_empty() {
789:             self.sel = want.iter().cloned().collect();
790:             if let Some(i) = self.items.iter().position(|e| want.contains(&e.loc)) {
791:                 self.focus = Some(i);
792:                 self.anchor = Some(i);
793:                 self.scroll_to = Some(i);
794:             }
795:         }
